sql_templates.query: WITH latest_stage AS (SELECT sector, COUNT(*) AS count, stage FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) GROUP BY sector, stage), previous_stage AS (SELECT sector, COUNT(*) AS count, stage FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months') GROUP BY sector, stage) SELECT latest_stage.sector, latest_stage.stage, latest_stage.count - COALESCE(previous_stage.count, 0) AS change FROM latest_stage LEFT JOIN previous_stage ON latest_stage.sector = previous_stage.sector AND latest_stage.stage = previous_stage.stage;
